text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — we have scheduled maintenance on gpu-pool-2 tomorrow 2026-03-18 03:00-04:30 UTC. During the window batch jobs will be draining and noisy; asking to temporarily mute low-severity batch alerts and route them to #eng-batch (no pager).

Priya Rao: Thanks Alex. Do you want me to own the routing change + handoff or should Ben do the change and I do the oncall swap?

Ben Torres: I can push the routing tweak. Will open a tiny PR and apply a scoped policy. Planning: set policy `batch-gpu-usage` to severity="warning" -> route:#eng-batch, remove pager; keep `system-out-of-memory` alone (pager stays).

Marta Silva: +1 on keeping OOM/instance-failures paged. Also we should add a short note in the runbook about the maintenance window and who to call if something escalates.

Ben Torres: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/834 (WIP). Patch snippet: ```yaml
alert_policies:
  - id: batch-gpu-usage
    action: route:#eng-batch
    pager: false
    temp_expires: 2026-03-18T04:45:00Z
  - id: system-out-of-memory
    action: route:#eng-oncall
    pager: true
```

Alex Chen: Good. Ben, once you apply, please post the deploy-bot message to this thread so we have an audit. Priya, if you can take the 03:00-05:00 UTC oncall slot (covers drift), that would be great. I'll do 00:00-03:00 then hand over.

Priya Rao: I can take the 03:00-05:00 slot. I'll update the schedule and add a one-line handoff note in the runbook: "03:00-05:00 UTC — Priya covering; watch batch alerts routed to #eng-batch (no pager)."

oncall-bot: Reminder: Priya Rao is scheduled for oncall 2026-03-18 03:00-05:00 UTC. Please confirm handoff in thread.

Priya Rao: Confirmed. I'll monitor for any high-sev alerts and will escalate to Alex if I see OOM or healthcheck flaps.

Ben Torres: Applied the change, infra-config PR merged and rolled. Deploy-bot: infra-config v1.42 deployed to production (change set: mute batch-gpu-usage).

oncall-bot: Deploy successful: infra-config v1.42 — routing update applied at 2026-03-18T02:50:12Z.

Marta Silva: Thanks all. Quick checklist for handoff: 1) PR merged (Ben) 2) Deploy success (bot) 3) Runbook updated (Priya) 4) Pager exceptions preserved (Alex). Anything else?

Alex Chen: Add a brief smoke test: run `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-pool-2` + `queuectl list jobs --pool gpu-pool-2 | head` and check that the batch alerts in the next 15m show up only in #eng-batch. If any unexpected paged alerts appear, escalate to me.

Priya Rao: Will run the smoke test at 02:55 UTC and post results here. :thumbsup:

Ben Torres: I'll keep an eye on the deploy logs until 03:05 and will revert the routing change if we see unintended drops. Command to revert: `alertctl rollback --policy batch-gpu-usage --to previous`

Priya Rao: Smoke test done 02:55 — nodes: 6 healthy, queue head shows draining jobs, and I see one `warning` routed to #eng-batch. No paged alerts. All good.

Marta Silva: Great, thanks. I'll update the maintenance calendar entry with this thread link for audit. :white_check_mark:
